regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Killington leads with 7" on Thursday, the only day of its forecast with a measured total. Whiteface follows at 5" and Stowe at 4". Forecasters expect cold, showery conditions through midweek, with gusty west winds Monday night, up to 46 mph at Whiteface.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler leads with 7" total, peaking at 3" Tuesday. Cypress Mountain has 2" total, mostly Sunday and Monday. Expect rain more often than snow here. Sunday brings strong southwest winds, gusting to 70 km/h at Whistler and 90 km/h near the Strait of Georgia at Cypress.

ahead.text: The Weather Prediction Center says a series of Pacific disturbances and moisture plumes will keep the Pacific Northwest unsettled, with mountain snow at higher elevations, through the week of Friday Nov 13. Its confidence in the timing of individual systems is moderate.
